questions.def: 'Should have' indicates an expectation in the past that wasn't met.
questions.question: He said he ___ finished the report by now.

questions.def: 'Having' is used as a gerund after verbs of mentioning and remembering.
questions.question: She mentioned ___ seen that movie before.

questions.def: 'Denied' is the correct past tense form to report the statement.
questions.question: He ___ stealing the money.

questions.def: 'Had' is needed for the past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: They informed us that the project ___ been delayed.

questions.def: 'Had' is the past perfect continuous form needed after reporting.
questions.question: She explained that she ___ been working all day.

questions.def: 'Go' is the bare infinitive after 'suggest' in reported speech.
questions.question: She suggested that we ___ to the beach.

questions.def: 'Was telling' maintains past tense consistency in reported speech.
questions.question: He claimed he ___ the truth, but nobody believed him.

questions.def: 'Had been' creates correct past perfect passive for reported speech.
questions.question: They reported that the suspect ___ apprehended.

questions.def: 'Explained' provides the basic past tense for reported speech.
questions.question: He ___ the situation in detail.

questions.def: 'Was planning' correctly backshifts 'is planning' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ to visit next year.

questions.def: 'Having' is the correct gerund form after 'mentioned'.
questions.question: He mentioned ___ seen her at the conference.

questions.def: 'Promised' is simple past, fitting reported speech.
questions.question: She ___ to help me with the project.

questions.def: 'Had' creates the past perfect continuous in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ been studying all night.

questions.def: 'Where' is correct to report an indirect question about location.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I was going.

questions.def: 'Stay' is the bare infinitive after 'insist' in reported speech.
questions.question: He insisted that I ___ for dinner.

questions.def: 'Were going' is the correct past continuous form after reporting.
questions.question: They mentioned that they ___ to the conference next week.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question showing uncertainty.
questions.question: She wondered ___ the package had arrived.

questions.def: 'Warned' provides the simple past form for reported speech.
questions.question: She ___ me not to go there alone.

questions.def: 'Had hidden' creates past perfect for earlier action in reported speech.
questions.question: He confided that he ___ the money.

questions.def: 'Taking' is correct gerund after 'suggested'.
questions.question: They suggested ___ a break.

questions.def: 'Advised' is correct simple past tense to match the context.
questions.question: They ___ us to invest in the company.

questions.def: 'Had already written' correctly places earlier action in the past.
questions.question: She said she ___ the letter.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect yes/no question.
questions.question: He inquired ___ I had finished the report.

questions.def: After 'insist' in reported speech, the subjunctive 'tell' is used.
questions.question: She insisted that he ___ her the truth, regardless of the consequences.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes the duration before the reporting verb.
questions.question: The witness testified that the suspect ___ the scene of the crime.

questions.def: 'Denied' correctly reports a past action of denying something.
questions.question: He ___ having ever met her, despite the evidence.

questions.def: 'Get' is the subjunctive form after 'recommend' in reported speech.
questions.question: The doctor recommended that she ___ more rest.

questions.def: Inversion after 'had' creates a conditional meaning in reported speech.
questions.question: She remarked that, ___, she would have declined the offer.

questions.def: 'Warned' is the correct past tense to report a warning.
questions.question: They ___ us against going there alone at night.

questions.def: Past tense 'was' agrees with singular 'government' and reporting verb.
questions.question: The article asserted that the government ___ aware of the risks.
